title: Difference
text: Calculate change in signal over one time step, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial condition for previous input} sets Initial condition; {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array
